note: NOTE: High-level v0 game rules (combat, progression, formulas, gathering, economy, death, level-up, and monster aggro/leash). Detailed combat math is in combat_formulas. Values are a starting baseline and may pivot after playtesting.

rows.notes: v0.1.2: was 5. Fewer free points so skill training is the real power-up.
Players move, jump, and attack in real time on 2D side-scrolling maps.
Combat skills are bound to hotkeys, spend MP, and have short cooldowns.

rows.value: max(min_dmg, floor(skill% × attack − defense)) — see combat_formulas
rows.notes: attack = (weapon_damage + main_stat × 2) × weapon_stat_multiplier. Full definitions, XP curve, HP/MP, potions, and a worked example are in the combat_formulas tab.
Monsters respawn on a timer in each map.

rows.value: basic +5%/rank; nature +12%; elemental +10%; spiritual +10% (to be tuned)
rows.notes: v0.1.2: raised (was +2/+8/+7/+7) because per-level gains were cut — rank-ups are the main power-up. Damage skills: +N percentage points of attack per rank (Power Strike 140% → 190% at rank 10). Buffs/shields: effect × (1 + N% × rank). Basic skills are known at rank 0 (base value); category skills are learned at rank 1 (base value) and scale from rank 2.

rows.value: each tree produces its category essence on a steep curve (sources/slots deprecated)
rows.notes: Item sources and gathering slots are retired. Each of Nature, Elemental, and Spiritual has one production node that yields only that tree's essence. Rank 0 yields nothing. At rank r, yield = 1.5 × 1.6^(r-1) /h (rank 1 = 1.5, rank 5 ≈ 9.8, rank 10 ≈ 103). Efficiency adds +% category material and category-essence drop rate while hunting. Hunter's Luck is a general looting node (+1% bonus drop-roll chance per rank, max 10). v0 draft; may pivot.
A single general looting node. Each rank adds +1% chance that a kill makes one extra roll on the same drop table (rank 10 = +10%). Costs a mix of all three category essences plus coins. To be tuned.

rows.value: category essences 40-60% (qty 1-3, bosses more); commons 30-40%; uncommons 2-6%; rares ~0.6-2%
rows.notes: v0.1.2: all drop rates doubled after playtest; relative rarity unchanged.

rows.value: materials + category essence + coins each rank; rares only at 5 and 10
rows.notes: Essence is an addition to the material recipe, not a replacement, and is the main power gate. Category skills and passives cost collected materials (commons in tens, plus a few 1-3% items, including a mixed-category ingredient on skills) PLUS that category's essence (rank 1 placeholder: 50) PLUS Copper Coin, then ×1.6 per rank. Basic skills cost Monster Essence 50 + Training Scroll 6 + Copper Coin 30 (then ×1.6). Rare drops (Heartwood, Earth Crystal, Holy Essence, Soul Shard, Stone Chunk, etc.) appear only as milestone requirements at ranks 5 and 10. Passive trees produce only category essence (commons are gathered from kills or exchanged at 10:1). Having a lot of category essence is a lot of power. To be tuned.

rows.value: 10 commons (or listed shards) = 1 matching category essence
rows.notes: Nature materials (Twig, Bark, Pebble, Clay, Wool, Feather, Fur) → Nature Essence. Earth Grit and Fire/Ice/Lightning/Earth Shards → Elemental Essence. Holy Dust and Soul Dust → Spirit Essence. Steep on purpose so essence stays desirable. See the exchange tab.

rows.value: basic from start; nature lv3+5 main stat; elemental lv6+10; spiritual lv8+15
rows.notes: Main stat is STR (Warrior), INT (Mage), or AGI (Rogue). Both the level and the stat requirement must be met. See unlock_requirements.

rows.value: lose 5% of current-level XP progress (not below 0); respawn in town; no item loss
rows.notes: On death, the player loses 5% of XP already earned toward the next level, floored at 0 progress for that level (they cannot drop a level). Respawn at Meadow Town after a short ~3s delay, with HP and MP restored to full. No items, coins, or essence are lost. This is the mild early-game / Meadows rule; later zones may be steeper. Placeholder.

rows.value: 3 ability points; full HP and MP restore; brief invulnerability
rows.notes: Each level grants 5 ability points, spent freely on STR, INT, AGI, or SPI (see ability_points_per_level). HP and MP are fully restored on level up. A brief ~1.5s invulnerability follows so a pack cannot finish the player mid-ding. Points are not auto-spent. Placeholder.

rows.value: aggressive aggro in range; passive until hit; leash back to spawn
rows.notes: Aggressive monsters (monsters.aggression = aggressive) aggro when the player enters ~8 tiles (placeholder). Passive monsters only fight back once attacked. If the player leaves ~20 tiles from that monster's spawn, or exits the area through a portal, the monster drops aggro, returns to spawn, and resets HP. Nearby aggressive pack-mates may assist if the player is also inside their aggro range (v0, to be tuned). Bosses (Old Stump, Night Stump) cannot be leashed out of Stump Hollow.
